items.text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO LOCAL GOVERNMENT

items.actClause:
AN ACT in relation to authorizing the Gold Coast public library district to
file with the county of Nassau assessor an application for a retroactive real
property tax exemption
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6354

SPONSOR: MARTINS
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to authorizing the Gold Coast public library district
to file with the county of Nassau assessor an application for a retroac-
tive real property tax exemption

 
PURPOSE:

To grant the Nassau County Assessor the authority to exempt the Gold
Coast Public Library District from liability for payment of real proper-
ty taxes due on the 2021-2022 assessment roll

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. This bill authorizes and directs the assessor of the County
of Nassau to accept an application from the Gold Coast Public Library
District for exemption from real property taxes pursuant to Section 406
of the Real Property Tax Law for the 2021-2022 assessment roll for their
property located in Oyster Bay. Upon satisfaction that the Gold Coast
Public Library District would have otherwise been entitled to said
exemption, the assessor may grant this exemption from all taxation
beginning with the 2021-2022 roll. If exemption is granted, the Gold
Coast Public Library District may be refunded any taxes paid and any
taxes, fines, penalties, liens or interest unpaid may be cancelled at
the discretion of the assessor and the Nassau County Legislature.

Section 2. Effective Date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The Gold Coast Public Library District purchased their property at 180
Glen Head Road in Oyster Bay after the taxable status date for the
2021-2022 assessment roll. This bill would authorize the assessor of the
County of Nassau to accept an application from the Gold Coast Library
for an exemption from real property taxes pursuant to Section 406 of the
real property tax law for the 2021-2022 assessment roll.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

Minor fiscal implications to local government.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.
